climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Cabernet Franc sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

blurb.text: A Loire Valley appellation for red wine made from Cabernet Franc, with Cabernet Sauvignon and Pineau d'Aunis allowed. It covers seven communes, including Montsoreau and Parnay, in Maine-et-Loire.
